name: Media Downloader
shortDescription: A minimal media downloader for BetterTouchTool Launcher powered by yt-dlp.
description: Download video or audio from YouTube, Facebook, Instagram, TikTok and many other yt-dlp supported sites directly inside BTT Launcher with format selection, thumbnail preview, live progress, speed, ETA, playlist folders and log support.
author: loaykhalifa
requirements: Apple Command Line Tools if BTT asks to compile Swift plugins
permissions: Runs /opt/homebrew/bin/yt-dlp to fetch media metadata, thumbnails and downloads
Runs /opt/homebrew/bin/ffmpeg and /opt/homebrew/bin/ffprobe through yt-dlp for media processing
Runs /opt/homebrew/bin/brew when the Update button is used to install or update yt-dlp and FFmpeg
Reads the clipboard only to prefill a URL when opening the plugin
Writes downloads to the selected folder, defaulting to ~/Downloads/BTT Media Downloads
installation: Restart BetterTouchTool or wait for plugin reload.
Open BTT Launcher and search for Media Downloader.
Paste a supported media URL, choose Video or Audio, choose a format and press Download.
